index 0000000..028a84d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/cors.go
@@ -0,0 +1,289 @@
+package chi
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"sort"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+// CORSOptions configures the CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) support
+// of a router, see CORS, Mux#EnableCORS and Mux#EnableCORSWithOptions.
+type CORSOptions struct {
+	// AllowOrigin is sent as Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Use "*" to allow
+	// any origin. An empty value sends no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header.
+	AllowOrigin string
+
+	// AllowMethods is sent as Access-Control-Allow-Methods on preflight
+	// requests. When it is empty, the methods that the router handles for the
+	// requested path are sent instead.
+	AllowMethods []string
+
+	// AllowHeaders is sent as Access-Control-Allow-Headers on preflight
+	// requests. When it is empty, the headers named by the request's
+	// Access-Control-Request-Headers are allowed.
+	AllowHeaders []string
+
+	// ExposeHeaders is sent as Access-Control-Expose-Headers, it names the
+	// response headers that scripts running in the browser may read.
+	ExposeHeaders []string
+
+	// MaxAge is how many seconds a browser may cache a preflight response,
+	// sent as Access-Control-Max-Age. Zero sends no header.
+	MaxAge int
+
+	// AllowCredentials sends Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.
+	AllowCredentials bool
+}
+
+// DefaultCORSOptions returns the options that Mux#EnableCORS uses: any origin,
+// the request headers an API commonly needs, preflight responses cached for
+// one hour, and the allowed methods detected from the routes.
+func DefaultCORSOptions() CORSOptions {
+	return CORSOptions{
+		AllowOrigin: "*",
+		AllowHeaders: []string{
+			"Accept",
+			"Authorization",
+			"Content-Type",
+			"X-CSRF-Token",
+			"X-Requested-With",
+		},
+		MaxAge: 3600,
+	}
+}
+
+// corsFallbackMethods are announced to a preflight request when neither the
+// options nor the router say which methods a path handles.
+var corsFallbackMethods = []string{
+	http.MethodGet,
+	http.MethodHead,
+	http.MethodPost,
+	http.MethodPut,
+	http.MethodPatch,
+	http.MethodDelete,
+	http.MethodOptions,
+}
+
+// CORS returns a middleware that sets the CORS headers on every response and
+// answers preflight OPTIONS requests with 204 No Content, along with the
+// Access-Control-Allow-Methods, Access-Control-Allow-Headers and
+// Access-Control-Max-Age headers.
+//
+// The allowed methods are options.AllowMethods or, when that is empty, the
+// methods the router handles for the requested path. A route that handles
+// OPTIONS itself keeps its handler, which runs after the headers are set.
+func CORS(options CORSOptions) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
+	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
+		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+			setCORSHeaders(w, r, options)
+			if r.Method != http.MethodOptions {
+				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+				return
+			}
+
+			methods := corsResourceMethods(r)
+			setPreflightHeaders(w, r, options, methods)
+			if corsContains(methods, http.MethodOptions) {
+				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+				return
+			}
+			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+// EnableCORS enables CORS on the router with DefaultCORSOptions.
+// See EnableCORSWithOptions.
+func (mx *Mux) EnableCORS() {
+	mx.EnableCORSWithOptions(DefaultCORSOptions())
+}
+
+// EnableCORSWithOptions enables CORS on the router. It adds the CORS
+// middleware, so the CORS headers are set and preflight requests are answered
+// whether or not a route matches, and it sets the method not allowed handler,
+// which lists the methods the route handles in the Allow header of its 405
+// response and answers a preflight request that reaches it.
+//
+// Like Use, it is best called before the routes are defined. Called after,
+// it wraps the routes defined so far.
+func (mx *Mux) EnableCORSWithOptions(options CORSOptions) {
+	cors := CORS(options)
+	if mx.handler != nil && !mx.inline {
+		mx.handler = cors(mx.handler)
+	} else {
+		mx.Use(cors)
+	}
+	mx.MethodNotAllowed(corsMethodNotAllowed(options))
+}
+
+// WithCORS creates a new inline group of the router, as Group does, that has
+// CORS enabled with DefaultCORSOptions, and returns it.
+func (mx *Mux) WithCORS() Rout
